plan.focus_en: Places with 那里 / 哪里, and time words before the verb (下午三点我去…).

items.title_en: Read and read aloud: 我要去中国
Guided mission: checking in at the airport

translations: Next month I'm going to China. I'll be flying for twelve hours.
My friend lives there. He says the people there are all really nice.
I'm getting ready. I've learned some Chinese, and I've bought lots of things.
My friend said: “When you come, we’ll go to lots of places together!”
I also want to give my friend a few things. I really want to go right now!
My teacher is called Teacher Wang. She’s really nice and smiles a lot.
At three in the afternoon I go to her home to study.
I can understand everything she says. When I make a mistake, she smiles and tells me.
We studied for two hours, and at the end we had a bite to eat together. She also gave me a book.
I think having a good teacher is really important!

missions.title: Checking in at the airport
missions.goal: Check in for your flight: show your passport, say where you're flying, check a bag, choose a seat and ask where to board.

steps.partner_zh: 你好，请给我看一下您的护照。
steps.partner_en: Hello, may I see your passport, please?
How many bags are you checking in?
OK. Boarding is at half past two this afternoon.

missions.closing_zh: 十二号登机口。一路平安！

missions.title: First Chinese class
missions.goal: Introduce yourself to your new teacher, say why you're learning Chinese and arrange the next class.

steps.partner_zh: 你好！请介绍一下你自己。
steps.prompt_en: Say hello to the teacher and that you're British.

steps.partner_zh: 你学习中文多长时间了？
steps.partner_en: How long have you been learning Chinese?
answers_en: I've been learning for a month.

steps.prompt_en: Say you want to travel in China.
answers_en: I want to travel in China.
Because I want to go to China.

steps.partner_en: Great! Do you find Chinese hard?
steps.prompt_en: Say it's a bit hard but interesting.
answers_en: A bit hard, but really interesting.
It's hard, but I really like it.

steps.partner_zh: 没关系，慢慢来。下次上课是星期二下午。
steps.partner_en: Don't worry, take it slowly. The next class is Tuesday afternoon.
steps.prompt_en: Say OK, see you on Tuesday.
answers_en: Thank you, teacher, see you Tuesday!
